name: Monitor LG 4K
description: 27-inch UltraFine 4K UHD (3840×2160) IPS display with VESA DisplayHDR 400 and DCI-P3 95% color gamut — ideal for design, editing, or everyday work. Comes with HDMI, DisplayPort, and a fully adjustable stand (tilt, height, pivot). White finish, excellent condition.

name: Cornetas Thonet-Vander
description: 2.0 desktop speaker system with 72W RMS output and distinctive 5.25" aramid fiber woofers in a solid wood cabinet. Connects via Bluetooth 5.0, aux, RCA, or optical — versatile for any setup. Full, rich sound with separate bass and treble controls.

name: PlayStation 5
description: Sony's flagship gaming console with ultra-fast SSD, ray tracing, and 4K gaming at up to 120fps. The DualSense controller's haptic feedback and adaptive triggers make gameplay feel more immersive than ever. Ready to play.

name: Televisor Sony 49"
description: 49-inch 4K UHD Smart TV with HDR and Sony's X-Reality Pro upscaling processor for sharp, vivid images on every source. Built-in Wi-Fi with access to all major streaming apps. Solid performer for movies, shows, and gaming.

name: Espumador de Leche
description: Electric milk frother that prepares hot and cold foam in under 90 seconds. Non-stick interior, 360° rotating base, and 240ml heating capacity — perfect for lattes, cappuccinos, and hot chocolate. Color vainilla.

name: Air Fryer
description: 5-liter digital air fryer with 1600W and 360° hot air circulation for crispy results with little to no oil. Digital controls with a 60-minute timer and adjustable temperature from 80°C to 200°C. Dishwasher-safe basket.

name: Filtro de Agua
description: Under-sink water purifier with granular activated carbon — removes chlorine, lead, iron, and trihalomethanes from tap water. 36-month filter lifespan and 100 L/h flow rate. Compact, low-maintenance, and highly effective.

name: Sistema WiFi 6 Mesh
description: WiFi 6 mesh system covering up to 3,900 sq ft with speeds up to 1,500 Mbps — replaces your router and extender in one clean setup. Two Gigabit ports per unit with Ethernet backhaul support and management via app. Supports up to 120 devices.
